decisions.reason: Changing the vehicle-group section from checkboxes to a fixed or customer-tailored line does not alter the separate result-explanation content or its scannable bullet format.
The vehicle-group presentation change does not alter the dashboard's score fields, heading, prominence, or result visibility.
A fixed vehicle-group line or customer-tailored vehicle-assessed line remains compatible with the existing requirement that vehicle information be editable for individual customers.
The source changes the dedicated vehicle-group section, not the footer's continued inclusion of vehicle-group information; the same message says the footer is working well.
Vehicle-group presentation is independent of the scoring-summary table and its required score fields.
The vehicle-group section change does not modify the separately specified internal-page header, its coverage, or its information fields.
The presentation of vehicle identity does not affect the content, ranking, or priority tiers of recommended security actions.
The front-page vehicle-group presentation has no effect on the final-page confidentiality warning or its visual treatment.
Changing how the vehicle group is displayed does not change the required RR01–RR04 variants or their score/risk-based selection.
The vehicle-group display change does not modify the required RR-01 footer code.
The vehicle-group display change does not modify the required RR-01 code in internal headers.
The vehicle-group presentation decision does not change the RR-01 identifier required in report-detail sections.
